name: Shared Metals
description: Several mods add the same metal.

pages.title: Shared Metals
pages.text:
Several mods add the same metal. In this pack each one has a single **canonical item**. Other mods' recipes now produce and use it, so only one kind exists in practice.\
\
Leftovers convert 1:1 in a crafting grid.

pages.title: Steel: TFMG
pages.text: The canonical steel. Alloyed, Big Cannons and Nuclear recipes now give this item. See [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG Steel](entry://industry/tfmg_steel)[#]().

pages.title: Old steel
pages.text: Alloyed, Big Cannons and Create Nuclear still have their own steel items, but no recipe makes them. Put an old ingot, nugget or block in a crafting grid to get TFMG steel. Recipes that ask for the steel tag still take either.

pages.title: Steel plates
pages.text: TFMG's Heavy Plate (three presses) is the one you make: Alloyed's one-press Steel Sheet is off. Both are in the steel plate tag, so old sheets still work in recipes.

pages.title: Other unified metals
pages.text:
- **Lead**: Create Nuclear's. TFMG lead converts. Only Nuclear's ore generates.
- **Bronze**: Alloyed's. Big Cannons bronze converts.
- **Cast iron**: still TFMG and Big Cannons, shared by tag.

pages.title: Lead Ingot
pages.text: Smelt Raw Lead from Create Nuclear's ore. TFMG's lead recipes accept this ingot too.

pages.title: Cast Iron Ingot
pages.text: Shared by TFMG and Create Big Cannons through the cast iron tag, so either works in tag-based recipes.

pages.title: Wire, sulfur, salt
pages.text: **Copper wire** is Create Crafts & Additions' (see [#](2E5AAC)[Electricity](entry://industry/electricity)[#]()); TFMG's converts. Each mod keeps its own copper spool, as they wire different machines. **Sulfur dust** is TFMG's; Alex's Caves sulfur converts. Salt and cocoa also unify, in Ratatouille.

pages.title: Single-source
pages.text:
Not shared: titanium, tungsten, platinum, mithril and zinc each come from one mod.\
\
Northstar's Martian Steel has its own tag and is not generic steel. Raw uranium joins Create Nuclear and Alex's Caves.
